title: The Bias of a Gyro When the Robot Stops: Knowing That It Is Still, Reading the Bias From a Few Seconds of Stillness, and How Often a Robot Must Stop to Keep Its Heading

questions.question: What should a gyro read when the robot is standing still?
options: Nothing: so what it does read is the bias plus noise

questions.question: A detector that looked at the wheels alone said still for how many of 200 samples of a robot being carried?
The bias read from a stop of 10 s was good to:
questions.explanation: The noise over the square root of the samples.

questions.question: With a stop of 2 s every 10 s the heading ended out by:
Why does the detector wait for a whole window?
questions.explanation: A moment of stillness is not stillness.

questions.question: What found the step in the bias?
options: The next stop, which read the gyro again
questions.explanation: A filter with no stops would not have.
